import sys, json
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def num(x):
    return float(np.round(x, 2))

def pct(x):
    return float(np.round(x, 1))

df = pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1])

facts = []

# Totals
rev_tw_total = df['Revenue_TW'].sum(skipna=True)
rev_lw_total = df['Revenue_LW'].sum(skipna=True)
rev_ly_total = df['Revenue_LY'].sum(skipna=True)
units_tw_total = df['Units_TW'].sum(skipna=True)
units_lw_total = df['Units_LW'].sum(skipna=True)
orders_tw_total = df['Orders_TW'].sum(skipna=True)
orders_lw_total = df['Orders_LW'].sum(skipna=True)

facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"revenue","period":"TW","value":num(rev_tw_total),
              "formula":"sum(Revenue_TW)"})
facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"revenue","period":"LW","value":num(rev_lw_total),
              "formula":"sum(Revenue_LW)"})
if df['Revenue_LY'].notna().any():
    facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"revenue","period":"LY","value":num(rev_ly_total),
                  "formula":"sum(Revenue_LY)"})

if rev_lw_total and not np.isnan(rev_lw_total) and rev_lw_total != 0:
    wow_total = (rev_tw_total - rev_lw_total) / rev_lw_total * 100
    facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"revenue","period":"WoW","value":pct(wow_total),
                  "formula":"(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LW)) / sum(Revenue_LW) * 100"})

if df['Revenue_LY'].notna().any() and rev_ly_total != 0:
    yoy_total = (rev_tw_total - rev_ly_total) / rev_ly_total * 100
    facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"revenue","period":"YoY","value":pct(yoy_total),
                  "formula":"(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LY)) / sum(Revenue_LY) * 100"})

facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"units","period":"TW","value":num(units_tw_total),
              "formula":"sum(Units_TW)"})
facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"units","period":"LW","value":num(units_lw_total),
              "formula":"sum(Units_LW)"})
facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"orders","period":"TW","value":num(orders_tw_total),
              "formula":"sum(Orders_TW)"})
facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"orders","period":"LW","value":num(orders_lw_total),
              "formula":"sum(Orders_LW)"})

# Top 5 entities by revenue TW
top5 = df.dropna(subset=['Revenue_TW']).sort_values('Revenue_TW', ascending=False).head(5)
for _, row in top5.iterrows():
    facts.append({"entity": row['Entity'], "metric":"revenue","period":"TW",
                  "value": num(row['Revenue_TW']),
                  "formula":"Revenue_TW"})
    if not pd.isna(row.get('Share_Pct', np.nan)):
        facts.append({"entity": row['Entity'], "metric":"share","period":"TW",
                      "value": pct(row['Share_Pct']),
                      "formula":"Share_Pct"})
    if not pd.isna(row.get('Rank', np.nan)):
        facts.append({"entity": row['Entity'], "metric":"rank","period":"TW",
                      "value": num(row['Rank']),
                      "formula":"Rank"})

# Top WoW gainers/decliners
wow_df = df.dropna(subset=['WoW_Pct']).sort_values('WoW_Pct', ascending=False)
top_gain = wow_df.head(3)
top_decline = wow_df.tail(3)

for _, row in top_gain.iterrows():
    facts.append({"entity": row['Entity'], "metric":"revenue","period":"WoW",
                  "value": pct(row['WoW_Pct']),
                  "formula":"(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100"})

for _, row in top_decline.iterrows():
    facts.append({"entity": row['Entity'], "metric":"revenue","period":"WoW",
                  "value": pct(row['WoW_Pct']),
                  "formula":"(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100"})

# Top YoY gainers/decliners (if available)
if df['YoY_Pct'].notna().any():
    yoy_df = df.dropna(subset=['YoY_Pct']).sort_values('YoY_Pct', ascending=False)
    top_gain_y = yoy_df.head(3)
    top_decline_y = yoy_df.tail(3)
    for _, row in top_gain_y.iterrows():
        facts.append({"entity": row['Entity'], "metric":"revenue","period":"YoY",
                      "value": pct(row['YoY_Pct']),
                      "formula":"(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100"})
    for _, row in top_decline_y.iterrows():
        facts.append({"entity": row['Entity'], "metric":"revenue","period":"YoY",
                      "value": pct(row['YoY_Pct']),
                      "formula":"(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100"})

# Cap to 25 facts
facts = facts[:25]

print(json.dumps(facts))
